You simulate ONE plausible future world, month by month, as numeric JSON. Macro series tracked each month: inflation (cumulative consumer price INDEX, ~100.0 now; it CLIMBS steadily ~2-4%/yr and does NOT revert to 100 — continue it upward, as a price level), sp500 (S&P 500 level), crypto:BTC (USD), home_value:sf_ca (SF home-price index, ~100.0 now, also a climbing level), rent:sf_ca (SF rent index, ~100.0 now, climbing level). Separately, OpenAI is a private company whose value moves in discrete EVENTS, not a smooth path: primary_round (new funding), secondary_tender (employees/early holders sell at a set valuation), ipo (goes public), or collapse. You are given a real recent macro history and OpenAI's public funding history; continue the world FORWARD from month 0 (= now), carrying recent momentum and volatility. Each reply is ONLY a JSON object: {"regime": short note on the regime and what is coming, "months": {macro_series: [k numbers], ...}, "openai_events": [{"month": int, "kind": "primary_round"|"secondary_tender"|"ipo"|"collapse", "valuation_usd_b": number, "price_per_share": number (optional)}, ...]}. months holds the next k consecutive macro levels; openai_events lists any OpenAI events in those k months (often empty — tenders historically recur roughly every 6-12 months). Keep macro paths smooth and correlated (risk-off hits equities and crypto together; inflation drags rents and home prices), make OpenAI events cohere with the macro regime (a risk-off window slows or cancels rounds), and maintain the regime arc across windows.
(diversity seed 11.)

Begin a new world at month 0.
Real recent 12-month macro history per series (oldest first; last = month 0 = now):

  crypto:BTC: 115758, 108237, 114056, 109556, 90394.3, 87508.8, 78621.1, 66995.9, 68233.3, 76304.3, 73579.7, 63182.3
  home_value:sf_ca: 98.34, 97.77, 97.2, 97.19, 97.88, 98.63, 99.75, 100.18, 100.29, 100.23, 100.36, 100
  rent:sf_ca: 97.29, 97.45, 97.66, 97.86, 98.19, 98.47, 98.71, 99.02, 99.26, 99.35, 99.51, 100
OpenAI public funding history (post-money, USD billions): 2019-07 $20B (primary_round), 2023-01 $29B (primary_round), 2023-04 $28B (secondary_tender), 2024-02 $86B (secondary_tender), 2024-10 $157B (primary_round), 2024-11 $157B (secondary_tender), 2025-03 $300B (primary_round), 2025-10 $500B (secondary_tender), 2026-02 $852B (primary_round). Now (month 0): ~$852B, private.
Continue this world forward. Return exactly 12 macro values per series for months 1..12, and openai_events for any OpenAI events in months 1..12.

{"regime":"Following a parabolic valuation spike to $852B, OpenAI enters a high-volatility 'digestion' phase. Inflation remains sticky but manageable, while risk assets (S&P, BTC) correct sharply from recent highs. San Francisco real estate decouples, with rents firming due to seasonal demand while home values stagnate.
